The CY2025 final rule (November 2024) added a Health Equity Benchmark Adjustment that raises the spending benchmark for ACOs based on their proportion of beneficiaries enrolled in the Part D low-income subsidy or dually eligible for Medicaid. The CY2026 final rule (November 2025) then removed the health equity adjustment to quality scores starting in 2026 and renamed the benchmark adjustment the population adjustment.
